# Saved pages

For a page or state the crawl never saw (behind a login, after a click or a form): open it in Chrome,
press Ctrl+S (Webpage, Complete), and save it into `saved-pages/<PageClass>/` (a new page type:
`saved-pages/NEW-<what it is>/`). The AI reads it to find the locators a story needs. Never save a page
with personal data on it.
